name: prompt-cache-meter
description: Band showing token usage, prompt-cache hit ratio, expiry countdown and cache warnings.

defaultTtl.title: Default cache TTL
defaultTtl.description: Which prompt-cache lifetime the countdown assumes until you press a TTL button.

showCacheClock.title: Show the cache countdown
showCacheClock.description: Show the second row with the cache clock and the TTL buttons.

showCacheWarnings.title: Show cache warnings
showCacheWarnings.description: Warn when the cache is about to expire (last 60 seconds) and when the hit ratio drops by 30 points or more between turns.
